name: Volza
description: Volza is a global trade intelligence platform providing shipment-level customs records, export-import tracking, and verified buyer-supplier intelligence across 203 countries to help businesses monitor global supply chains, track competitors, and find verified commercial partners.
best_for: Positioned for global importers, exporters, sourcing managers, freight forwarders, and trade analysts needing shipment-level customs data, verified supplier contacts, and global competitor trade tracking.
features: Customs shipment records and import-export data aggregated across 203 countries
Verified global buyer and supplier directories with direct executive contact intelligence
Competitor supply chain monitoring with detailed bill of lading and shipment tracking
HS Code lookup and international product trade volume analytics
Exportable shipment datasets and market reports formatted for CSV and Excel
Custom workspace organization for tracking supplier portfolios and automated shipment alerts

tiers.name: Startup
tiers.notes: Covers 108 countries (excluding 25 premium countries). Includes 4,800 searches/year, 75 workspaces, 1,000 profile downloads, and 150 contact credits.

tiers.name: SME
tiers.notes: Covers all 203 countries including premium nations. Includes unlimited searches, 300 workspaces, 10,000 profile downloads, and 450 contact credits.

tiers.name: Corporate
tiers.notes: Enterprise tier covering all 203 countries with unlimited searches, 600 workspaces, 22,000 profile downloads, and 1,000 contact credits.

pros: Comprehensive customs coverage spanning 203 countries with shipment-level bill of lading detail
Transparent annual pricing tiers published upfront compared to closed-quote legacy trade data vendors
Integrated executive contact information and direct phone/email data alongside shipment histories
cons: Annual commitment with high entry price point ($1,500/year) not suited for casual or one-off lookups
Startup tier excludes 25 major premium trade countries

faq.question: Does Volza offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Volza offers a 7-day free trial allowing users to explore the platform interface and search features with limited data access before committing to an annual plan.

faq.question: How much does Volza cost?
faq.answer: Volza plans are billed annually: Startup is $1,500/year (108 countries, 4,800 searches), SME is $4,500/year (203 countries, unlimited searches), and Corporate is $9,600/year (203 countries, 22,000 downloads).

faq.question: What kind of data does Volza provide?
faq.answer: Volza aggregates official customs shipment records, bills of lading, HS codes, pricing trends, and verified buyer/supplier company profiles across 203 countries.
